paper.title_en: Towards a Holographic dual of Carrollian BCFT
paper.abstract_en: In this work we aim to lay the foundation of flat version of AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ correspondence through Carrollian framework. We begin with discussing the recently discovered Boundary Carrollian Conformal Algebra (BCCA), the symmetry algebra of Carrollian BCFT. We identify this algebra at the null infinity of flat spacetime with appropriate choice of the end-of-the-world (EOW) brane. The properties of this EOW brane have been analysed both intrinsically and by taking flat limit from its AdS counterpart. We also find that the global as well as asymptotic symmetries of flat spacetime restricted by this EOW brane coincide exactly with the symmetries of BCCA.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文为平直时空中的全息对应关系（Carrollian BCFT）建立了基础，与全息凝聚态主题高度相关，并具有深刻的理论深度。
decision.title_zh: 走向 Carrollian BCFT 的全息对偶
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们旨在通过 Carrollian 框架为 AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ 对应的平面版本奠定基础。我们首先讨论最近发现的 Boundary Carrollian Conformal Algebra (BCCA)，即 Carrollian BCFT 的对称代数。我们将该代数在平直时空的无穷远处识别为具有适当选择的端世界膜（EOW brane）。我们已经从本质上以及通过从其 AdS 对应物取平直极限来分析该 EOW 膜的性质。我们还发现，由该 EOW 膜约束的平直时空的全局对称性和渐近对称性恰好与 BCCA 的对称性一致。
